Opposition calls for CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal and court probe

Opposition leaders Kharge and Abhishek said Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar should be removed and that a court‑monitored probe into the Election Commission’s functioning is needed after a report highlighted internal differences in the poll panel, describing his leadership as a ‘one‑man autocracy’.
